tools.name: get_available_slots
tools.description: Returns the start times that can be booked, with the hosts' calendars, buffers and limits already applied. Pass the invitee's `timezone` and either `date` (YYYY-MM-DD in `timezone`) or `from` and `to` (ISO, at most 62 days apart). With neither, it covers the next 7 days. `days` groups the slots by d

tools.name: check_series
tools.description: For event types with `repeatMax` (from get_public_profile): lists each meeting of a series that starts at `start` (one of the slots) and repeats `every` 1, 2 or 4 weeks at the same local time, and whether each is free. Book it with create_booking and `repeat` when `bookable` is true. A series is boo

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Books `start`, which must be one of the `slots` from get_available_slots. Free events are confirmed at once, unless the event type has `requiresApproval`: then it's a request (status=pending_approval) that holds the time until a host approves or declines it, and the invitee hears either way by email

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Returns a booking by its id and token (from create_booking), or its manageUrl passed as both, with `changeableUntil`, `refundableUntil`, `canCancel` and `cancelReasonRequired`. For a series, `series` lists every meeting with its own manageUrl.

tools.name: reschedule_booking_as_invitee
tools.description: Moves a confirmed booking to `start` with the same hosts. Get valid times from get_available_slots with this `bookingId` and `token`. The calendar event is updated and its provider notifies attendees. Payment carries over. Not possible after `changeableUntil` (409 change_too_late).

tools.name: cancel_booking_as_invitee
tools.description: Cancels a booking by its id and token. The event is removed from the host's calendar. Paid bookings cancelled before `refundableUntil` are refunded in full. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_booking, join_waitlist · Private data: get_available_slots, create_booking, get_booking, reschedule_booking_as_invitee, cancel_booking_as_invitee · Public sink: create_booking, join_waitlist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_booking, join_waitlist · Private data: get_available_slots, create_booking, get_booking, reschedule_booking_as_invitee, cancel_booking_as_invitee · Public sink: create_booking, join_waitlist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
